reviews.evidence: Read real GitLab main.rs, policy.rs, watch_policy.rs, Cargo.toml, docker-compose.rust-watch.yml and workflow. CLI watch loops over existing bounded catchup, exits on error, handles SIGTERM/SIGINT with tokio::select, per-peer cursor remains in isolated SQLite. New opt-in watch container and CI config source added. Actual Rust compiled/Telegram login/session/watch E2E not executed, no complete Go 17-op file service.

Source limits watch poll 15..3600 seconds and scan budget 1..10000, no public ports, nonroot read-only container, private bind, cap-drop, no-new-privileges, limited restart count. SIGTERM on an in-flight scan could leave idempotent inbox events but no new cursor if cancelled; this needs actual runtime testing. No Cargo.lock, no rustc/docker, remote CI provider failed, no GitHub job logs; not an independent security review.

findings.finding: Watch only records native TDX1 metadata and does not implement Telegram updates of older messages, file drive read/write or 17-op Go parity.
Nested Cargo.lock has not been resolved; Grammers code/CI/Docker are uncompiled and may contain errors.
Effective GitLab-to-GitHub bridge #3099037733 failed with child skipped; no native Rust jobs/e2e evidence.
